questions: Trace declared versus escalated chains and quota_pool/model cooldown identities.
Preserve exit 75 and zero functional-failure increments for availability faults.
decision: Use one coherent allowed-provider chain and a bounded availability policy with explicit quota scopes, combined retry budgets and non-secret route fingerprints.
code_observations: availability.read accepts a bounded version1 ledger with cooldowns, per-phase state and compact events; unavailable records categorized failures rather than raw model output.

availability.select fingerprints route inputs, derives a chain and applies visited/cooldown/CLI checks. The current fixed failure slot and escalated-tier chain must not leak into the new coherent switching policy.
workload_routing identity and cooldown keys already distinguish provider profiles and pools; reuse them instead of adding a second incompatible identity scheme.
implementation_steps: Specify a stable candidate identity containing host, backend profile, resolved model and quota pool, with null for unknown metadata. Never store endpoint credentials.
Preserve exit75 when no allowed candidate is currently available. Bound probes and attempts per run; honor cooldown before consulting a paid model.
Add an availability-intent contract for the future switch controller: candidate order and effective rung are explicit; the selector must not secretly rebuild a different semantic chain.
Fingerprint every option that changes candidate construction, including phase and switch configuration. Keep version1 ledgers readable and discard only stale cached intent, not useful cooldowns.
Differentiate missing executable, authentication, quota, transient capacity and invalid model. An invalid model triggers bounded catalog repair or a plan defect, not unlimited provider cycling.
Track quota scope and observation expiry independently from functional failure evidence and provider capability.
Document and cap the combined runner, CLI and SDK retry budget; report unobservable internal retries as unknown.
Include allowed-provider, privacy, workload, snapshot and effective-routing settings in the availability fingerprint.
proposed_acceptance_tests: Quota in one configured pool does not block another pool unless the configuration explicitly shares it.
Availability failures leave functional failure counts and semantic ladder evidence unchanged.
Fallback-disabled and CLI-pinned cases never widen the allowed chain.
A changed route fingerprint invalidates cached intent while retaining unrelated valid cooldowns.
Every eligible unavailable candidate yields a bounded, redacted reason; all-unavailable returns75 without a spin loop.
Quota exhaustion in one configured pool leaves another observed-independent pool eligible.
A fallback that violates required capabilities or data policy is rejected with a reason.
SDK retry fixtures cannot multiply an unbounded runner wait.
Availability pauses preserve subtasks without adding a functional failure.

cost_model: Compare wall time and all paid requests per validated task, including failed and hidden retries. Quota remaining and API cash cost are separate constraints, never silently converted into one numeric price.
unverified: Provider error strings and quota grouping can change. Live account discovery is unverified here and must be stored as dated evidence.
The independence of a user account quota pool is not established by a public model menu. Scope comes from verified account metadata or explicit configuration with provenance.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated provider invocation, live quota/cost benchmark, independent model review, or Windows runtime test was performed in this research revision.
previous_decision: Keep availability as a separate bounded state machine, with stable provider/model/quota-pool identity and no functional-failure inflation.
revision_delta: Beyond cooldown correctness, the revision includes hidden SDK/CLI retry multiplication, privacy-preserving fallback constraints and quota observations that expire independently of capability evidence.
decision_analysis: Availability is not a capability verdict. A rejected request may consume no useful attempt, while an interrupted stateful worker may already have edited files. Record availability events and functional outcomes separately, and reconcile uncertain side effects before launching a substitute. Do not reduce a provider slot from the total number of all historical failures.

Use a chain selected by an explicit stable policy and carry the same candidate identity from ladder selection into dispatch. A recalculation at the escalated tier must either be forbidden in the new mode or be a named, tested reordering event. Account, backend, model and quota-pool identity should be separate non-secret fields; cooldown one observed scope without disabling unrelated pools.

Backoff needs jitter, a maximum wait and a global retry budget that includes SDK or CLI automatic retries. Otherwise a nominal eight-attempt task can perform many more API attempts, exhaust a subscription and keep emitting heartbeats without progress. Record opaque internal attempt counts as unknown rather than reporting only runner invocations as total model requests.

Fallback must preserve confidentiality, permitted provider lists, required tool/schema capabilities and spending consent. A cheaper or available provider is not eligible if it violates one of these constraints. Exhausted eligible availability should pause with a persisted next action; it must neither silently add a provider nor call the most expensive route indefinitely.

baseline_anchor_check: All listed file hashes matched the preserved 0.11.0 source in this revision. This is integrity checking, not a second full code audit.
applicability_rule: Refresh only evidence contradicted by the installed CLI, selected account/billing plan or changed code contract. Unknown required capability blocks that candidate; it does not justify widening permissions.
identity_contract: Keep capability identity separate from availability identity: changing only a quota pool, request ID, log path or credential reference cannot create a stronger rung. Resolve known aliases and native effort before deduplication; retain the harness/backend boundary rather than equating model-family names across hosts.
